metadata.title: Award-winning custom home builder
metadata.description: Greenwood Homes is an award-winning custom home builder crafting exceptional homes across Lake Tahoe, California, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah since 1998.

sections.purpose: Orient the visitor and provide navigation to the key verified destinations on the site.
Establish Greenwood Homes as an award-winning custom home builder and invite the visitor to explore the portfolio.
proof: Award-winning custom home builder
Building custom homes since 1998 (over 25 years)
Serving Lake Tahoe, California, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah

sections.purpose: Present the full range of construction services offered to clients.
proof: Custom home building
Remodel and renovation
Pre-construction budget and timeline planning
Construction management
Sustainability and green building with LEED Accredited Professionals on staff
Post-construction support with an ironclad warranty

sections.purpose: Build credibility through track record, landmark projects, and the experienced team.
proof: Licensed general contractor in California, Nevada, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah
Completed over 50 custom homes
Built the Tahoe Provisions Market at the Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe
Completed two ground-up custom homes for one repeat client
Superintendents with 20-50 years in construction and LEED-accredited project managers

sections.purpose: Showcase notable completed homes to demonstrate craft and range of styles.
proof: Notable 2025/2024 projects include Cutting Edge Modern, Lakeview Serenity, Lakeview Chalet, Clear Creek Fairway, Cabin in the Woods, and Hale Pakika
Projects span Lake Tahoe, California, Idaho, and Hawaii
Homes range from contemporary to mountain chalet and island retreat styles

sections.purpose: Use client testimonials to reinforce quality, integrity, and delivery under time and budget.
proof: Projects completed under time and under budget
Trusted by clients on cost-plus contractual agreements
Repeat, enthusiastic recommendations from clients across Lake Tahoe, Texas, and Hawaii
